Set up GitHub Actions with the project's Pixi environments

Source: R/use_pixi_github_action.R
use_pixi_github_action.Rd

Write a GitHub Actions workflow that installs the project's environments exactly as pixi.lock records them, with setup-pixi, so CI uses the same R and packages as your computer. It replaces setup-r, setup-r-dependencies and setup-pandoc from r-lib/actions, whose other actions run as usual on top.

  • "check": R CMD check, with r-lib's check-r-package, for each environment on each operating system. The environments need rcmdcheck, as use_pixi_check_matrix()'s do.

  • "test-coverage": test coverage, reported to Codecov. The environment needs covr and xml2.

  • "pkgdown": build the pkgdown site and publish it to GitHub Pages. The environment needs pkgdown and pandoc.

  • "task": run one of the project's Pixi tasks, e.g. to render a report.

In a package, "check", "test-coverage" and "pkgdown" also need the package's dependencies from DESCRIPTION, Suggests included. rpix warns about each environment that lacks any of these.

The operating systems are those of the project's platforms that GitHub runs: Linux (linux-64), macOS (osx-arm64) and Windows (win-64). Add platforms with pixi_add_platform(). Pixi is pinned to the version you have, and the workflow fails if pixi.lock is out of date with pixi.toml, so commit both.

Usage

use_pixi_github_action(
  workflow = c("check", "test-coverage", "pkgdown", "task"),
  environments = NULL,
  task = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  path = NULL
)

Arguments

workflow

Which workflow: "check", "test-coverage", "pkgdown" or "task".

environments

Optional. The environments to use; "test-coverage" and "pkgdown" use the first. Defaults to those that have what the workflow needs: for "check" all of them, and for "test-coverage" and "pkgdown" the first, or else the default environment. "task" defaults to the default environment.

task

For "task", the task to run.

overwrite

If TRUE, replace a workflow that's there.

path

The project. Defaults to the working directory.

Value

The path to the workflow file, invisibly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
use_pixi_github_action("check")
use_pixi_github_action("check", environments = c("r44", "r45"))
use_pixi_github_action("task", task = "render")
} # }
